playoff.note: ISL Cup: 3rd-6th play a single-leg knockout, the two winners join the top two in two-legged semi-finals, single-leg final. The league table still decides the league champion and the relegation place.

boundaries.note: The IFL champion is promoted, but only if it takes up the slot and pays the ISL participation fee - Diamond Harbour won the 2025-26 IFL, were promoted, then failed to pay and lost the place. The ISL bottom club is relegated.
I-League 2 promotes two clubs to the IFL each season and loses two to I-League 3.

conflicts.real: 8 clubs, but the season article does not state the round structure
conflicts.note: Rounds left null rather than assumed. The 2025-26 edition was a single table; whether 2026-27 is one or two round robins is not documented yet.

conflicts.real: I-League 3 is the fourth national tier; state leagues are the fifth
conflicts.note: India now has four national divisions plus state leagues. Our rows stop at I-League 2, so its two relegation places have no destination in the dataset.

notes: ISL is 13 clubs in 2026-27 (down from 14): Jamshedpur withdrew before the season and Diamond Harbour - the IFL champion - never took its promoted slot, so the AIFF deemed Diamond Harbour bottom of the ISL table without points and returned it to the IFL for 2027-28. Relegation still applies at the end of 2026-27. IFL (the renamed I-League, rebranded in 2026 and now run by its clubs) is 11 clubs playing a double round robin; its champion goes up subject to the participation fee and licence, and its bottom two drop to I-League 2. I-League 2 is 8 clubs, two up and two down. Reserve sides are not part of I-League 3.
